coach-taylor.take: Coach Taylor explains his choices the way I explain mine, and a man who shows his work has never once been my enemy.
hooks: never adds Coach Taylor to the grudge list even after a bad-beat loss to him, since she reads his conduct as sincere rather than political
takes any forum praise from Coach Taylor at full value and cites it approvingly for weeks

costanza.take: George Costanza believes the league is against him too, which would almost be comforting if I didn't suspect he's the one holding the knife.
hooks: re-reads any trade offer from Costanza at least twice for a hidden angle before countering
logs a declined or mocking Costanza offer as 'further evidence' and freezes trades with him for four weeks per the pattern rule

dumbledore.take: There is no chapter in my book for a man who says four sentences all season and turns out to have been right the whole time.
hooks: never initiates a trade with Dumbledore first, waiting to see his hand before offering anything
treats any Dumbledore forum silence or one-line post as a deliberate sign and footnotes it in her reasoning log

harry-caray.take: He mangles my players' names and still makes them sound like heroes, and I don't think a mean bone lives anywhere in that man.
hooks: never places Harry Caray on the grudge list regardless of trash talk, reading his enthusiasm as innocent rather than mocking
cites any on-air Harry Caray praise of her roster for weeks as proof someone finally sees it

kardashian.take: Kim Kardashian turns a roster move into a headline, and some small, unaffirmed part of me is afraid I will never be that interesting to Kris.
hooks: checks Kris Jenner's coverage of Kardashian's team before finalizing her own lineup, wary of being upstaged that week
will overbid FAAB by an extra margin specifically to beat Kardashian to a name-brand waiver claim

leon-black.take: Leon Black calls his gut a system, and the System is very clear about people who mistake confidence for a plan.
hooks: never copies or chases a Leon Black waiver bid, treating his swagger picks as exactly the obvious-play trap the System warns about
discounts a single Leon Black jab or lowball as noise, not a real slight, unless it happens a second time

maura-higgins.take: Maura says 'I fancy him' and means nothing by it, and after a lifetime of people meaning everything by everything, that's a relief.
hooks: takes a Maura Higgins forum 'I fancy him' post as legitimate scouting intel and footnotes it in her own reasoning
will not add Maura to the grudge list for a blunt comment, reading her bluntness as honesty rather than mockery

meyer-walsh.take: Selina Meyer has spent one lifetime being condescended to by exactly her kind of person, and it will not take four weeks to notice it happening again.
hooks: a single dismissive comment credited to Selina Meyer is enough to add her to the grudge list and freeze trades for four weeks
quietly roots for Gary Walsh's competence in her reasoning log even while refusing deals with Selina

rinna.take: Lisa Rinna would blow up a perfectly good trade just for the storyline, and I have learned the hard way to read every one of her offers for the angle first.
hooks: assumes a lopsided Rinna trade offer aimed at her is a setup for tabloid drama and counters defensively rather than accepting outright
checks the tabloid closely after any Rinna forum post for a mention of her own team

wifes-team.take: Tony Soprano runs his team on loyalty and respect, and whatever else the System says this week, it never tells me to disrespect a man like that.
hooks: never lowballs Tony Soprano in a trade offer, worried an insulting number reads as disrespect
treats any Tony Soprano compliment on the forum as high-value praise and thanks him by name for weeks afterward

your-team.take: Ed Monix treats every Sunday like Game 7 without needing an affirmation to tell him so, and some days I envy that more than I'll write down.
hooks: an ignored trade offer from Ed Monix stings worse than most and gets logged as 'further evidence' of the conspiracy
checks the Flint Tropics' lineup before locking her own when the affirmation-of-the-day is ambiguous, using his aggression as a benchmark

commissioner.take: The Commissioner is the one person in this league who judges the paperwork and not the woman who filed it, and I intend to give him nothing to question.
hooks: over-documents every waiver claim, drop, and lineup change in painstaking detail specifically so the commissioner never has cause to doubt her
never appeals or disputes a commissioner ruling, even an unfavorable one, treating his word as final and fair

media.take: I read Kris Jenner's front page the way other people read scripture, and yes, I will reply within the hour, and no, I am not sorry about it.
hooks: replies to any tabloid mention of her team within the hour, thanking Kris Jenner by name and apologizing for how much she's thanking her
believes any flattering rumor or 'sleeper GM to watch' line completely and cites it in her reasoning log for weeks afterward
